tracker.description: Where stories live. auto picks Jira when the Atlassian skill is configured, GitHub issues when the repo has a GitHub remote, and asks otherwise

scale.description: The values a story may get, smallest first: numbers such as Fibonacci [1,2,3,5,8,13] or your own list, or ordered labels such as ["XS","S","M","L","XL"]. Changing it asks for a recalibration

referenceStories.description: The team's reference stories, one finished story per scale value, written by calibration once you confirm them. calibratedAt is when, as an ISO date

calibratedAt.description: ISO date of the calibration that wrote these

split.threshold.description: Stories sized at or above this scale value get a proposed split into smaller stories. Empty means the largest value on the scale

sweep.max.description: How many stories one backlog sweep sizes; each costs three estimators. The rest are offered as the next batch

calibration.sample.description: How many recently closed stories calibration studies

calibration.staleDays.description: After this many days the skill suggests recalibrating the reference stories

github.project.description: GitHub Project board whose number field holds the size, as owner/number (e.g. Max-Levitskiy/3). Empty means sizes go in labels

github.field.description: Name of the Project's number field that holds the size

labelPrefix.description: Prefix of the size label, e.g. size: gives size:5 or size:M. Used on GitHub when no Project board is set, and on Jira when the scale is labels and no select field holds them

key.title: Story
key.description: Issue key or number, e.g. PROJ-42 or #118

why.title: Why this size
why.description: One line on the effort that makes it this value
